jobs.description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Behind every breakthrough is a blueprint: ready to shape the strategy that propels innovation?As a Senior Sustainability Consultant in our Corporate Functions team become the heart of our organization by developing strategies, refining processes, and implementing initiatives that empower our business to thrive.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Taking a leading role in the preparation, continuous enhancement, and strategic development of Infineon’s Sustainability Statement and non-financial reporting in accordance with CSRD, ESRS Set2, EU Taxonomy, and other relevant regulatory requirements- Monitoring and assessing evolving sustainability regulations and disclosure frameworks, translating new requirements into efficient reporting processes, methodologies, and governance structures- Leading cross-functional initiatives to design, implement, and continuously improve robust ESG reporting processes, controls, KPIs, data models, and governance mechanisms- Supporting and coordinating external assurance activities, including interactions with auditors for Limited and Reasonable Assurance, while further developing a scalable and audit-ready ESG reporting environment- Managing and coordinating complex stakeholder landscapes across Sustainability, Finance, Legal, Compliance, HR, Procurement, and IT- Supporting sustainability-related communications and disclosures for customers, investors, rating agencies, auditors, and other external stakeholders- Driving strategic projects and the digitalization of sustainability reporting, including ESG governance, supply chain transparency, reporting systems, automation, and data governanceYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed- A degree in Sustainability, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, or a related field- A minimum of 3 years of hands-on work experience in sustainability reporting, ESG disclosure, non-financial reporting, or sustainability advisory within a multinational company, consultancy, or auditing environment. Experience in the semiconductor, technology, manufacturing, or industrial sector, or with a leading consulting or assurance firm, is an advantage- Proven experience in implementing and operationalizing ESRS/ESRS Set2, with a strong understanding of CSRD and other relevant sustainability frameworks, disclosures and ESG ratings- Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical reporting processes, governance concepts, and implementation roadmaps, while navigating evolving regulatory environments and driving change across international teams- Experience working with external auditors and supporting assurance engagements in a regulated reporting environment; experience in digital reporting, XBRL tagging, or regulatory data management is an advantage- Excellent analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving skills, combined with strong attention to detail- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, including interaction with senior management and cross-functional teams- Fluent English and German, both written and spoken#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/) and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/) at Infineon.Bárbara Pinto (http://www.linkedin.com/in/b%C3%A1rbara-pinto-992708223)

jobs.occupation: Digital Guest Service / Customer Support Supervisor (all genders) Hospitality in Berlin (Reservierungssachbearbeiter/in (Hotel))
jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleYou run the operational core of our digital guest service. Working from our Berlin headquarters, you join the Guest Service Supervisor team as the central point of contact for our Guest Service Agents worldwide. You make sure guests experience reliable care, and you free up the teams who speak with them every day. At the helm of our digital front desk, you keep every guest stay running smoothly behind the scenes.What You'll Do Operations. You support the Guest Service team in day-to-day work and keep our apartments running smoothly from behind the scenes.Quality. You design new quality concepts, monitor compliance with our standards in guest communication, and train the Agents continuously.Communication. You draft message templates that reach our guests reliably, personally and in the right tone.Second Level. You are the go-to contact for Agents when a case gets complex, and you take ownership when it matters most.Onboarding. You support the onboarding of new colleagues and the ongoing development of existing team members.Deputising. You cover for the Guest Service Team Lead during absences and keep the entire team in view.Interfaces. You coordinate closely with internal departments and external service partners, as a dependable partner who sees solutions through.What Makes You a Fit Service with Standards. You have a strong service mindset and are comfortable working at different times of day, including weekends on a regular, planned rotation.Experience. You bring professional experience as a Reservation Agent or Manager, Call Center Agent, Receptionist, or from another service-driven industry.Organisation. You organise and coordinate with confidence and approach problems with a solution-first mindset.Communication. You connect easily with different personalities and convey points of view, ideas and solutions clearly.Digital Tools. You work with software and digital solutions effortlessly. Experience with booking platforms and the property management systems Apaleo or Guesty is a plus.Languages. You speak and write German and English fluently (both at C1).Digital Curiosity. You spot potential in new tools and are excited about how AI can make your daily work more efficient.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. But we're working on it — and we'd love your help with that.What We OfferWe define levels by the work you own and the decisions you're accountable for, not by your title or years of experience. Beyond that: we've thought carefully about what people actually need to do their best work and live well — and we've built a benefits package that reflects that. Health, mobility, development, flexibility, and a few perks that come with being in the travel and hospitality business. Not much is missing. We'll walk you through the details when we meet.Next StepsIf this opportunity resonates with you, we’d be glad to learn more about your experience and perspective. Just send us your CV.Questions? Reach out to Natalie at karriere@homaris.de or +49 157 92465807. We value diversity and welcome applications from people of all genders, cultures and backgrounds.About usHomaris is a leading provider of serviced nano-apartments in prime urban locations and is pioneering a new generation of space-efficient apartment concepts with its nanopartment®. With more than 4,500 apartments secured under contract in cities including Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf and Dresden, Homaris ranks among Germany’s leading serviced-apartment brands. The company serves contemporary customer segments, including business travellers, tourists, digital nomads and corporate clients.The Homaris concept is based on the integration of a fully digitalised guest journey with maximum space efficiency, multifunctional design and intelligent space solutions. The nanopartment® is Homaris’s signature product, embodying innovative space efficiency, modern minimalism and a modular design concept that combines living, working and a sense of arrival within a compact footprint. Rotating, folding and sliding mechanisms allow the space to be reconfigured according to individual needs. In the future, the system is intended to become a standard feature across Homaris’s upcoming properties.

In this hands-on role, you will focus on high-precision assembly, internal equipment commissioning, and structured in-house service tasks for our polarizers:Assembly & Commissioning:• Perform structured assembly, testing, and commissioning of polarizers and sub-assemblies in our manufacturing area according to established technical specifications.• Execute standardized technical service, maintenance, and pre-delivery checks on in-house units.• Support hardware, mechanical, electrical, and fluidic component integrations.In-House Technical Support & Maintenance:• Carry out routine technical drawings, schematics, and work instructions.• Strong preference for structured, hands-on, and repeatable tasks with high attention to detail and consistency.• Good communication skills in Please contact:Sandra SchärliSenior Talent Acquisition Managermail: careers@nvision-quantum.comPlease note that, for data privacy reasons, we'll not review applications or CVs sent via email. Unsolicited applications can be submitted here .About usNVision is innovating quantum technology with a unique approach - leveraging organic molecules to change lives for the better. Our platform spans from quantum signal enhancement that enables metabolic imaging today to quantum computing that could transform drug discovery tomorrow. Headquartered in Ulm, Germany, and backed by leading investors from the United States and Europe, we are now entering a phase of global commercialization and expansion.With our POLARIS product line, we are extending the capabilities of standard MRIs to enable real-time metabolic imaging, transforming how diseases are detected, understood, and treated. Our work sits at the intersection of physics, engineering, chemistry, and medicine - translating cutting-edge science into clinical reality. We collaborate with leading academic and clinical partners worldwide, including Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, MD Anderson Cancer Center, Technical University of Munich, and the University of Cambridge.At NVision, we believe transformative innovation happens when talented people from different disciplines work together toward a shared, meaningful goal. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of nearly 180 employees from more than 30 nationalities, driven by curiosity, rigor, and a commitment to solving complex challenges. Here, ideas are valued, ownership is real, and collaboration spans functions, disciplines, and borders.If you are motivated by impact, thrive in dynamic environments, and want to contribute to something fundamentally new, NVision offers the opportunity to grow while building technology that changes lives._____ Please note that, for data privacy reasons, we'll not review applications or CVs sent via email. convert.• Run cadences across email, phone and LinkedIn in German and English together with the BDRs and AEs, and write first touches good enough that the reps reuse them.• Turn our Account News feed, which scores news, hiring and leadership changes every night, into meetings with the people those signals point to.• Build account maps, contact scores and segments for campaigns and events, so every play starts from the right twenty people rather than the right two thousand.• Run Clay enrichment triggered from Salesforce, so reps get emails, phone numbers and titles without asking anyone.• Build the AI agents the sales team uses every week (meeting prep, account research, post-call Salesforce updates, outreach drafts) and win adoption through short demos, an agent of the week, and fixing whatever made people stop using one.• Extend our GTM dashboard, a Next.js app on Vercel that reads Salesforce, with the funnel, BDR activity and account penetration views Business Development needs.• Keep the funnel data in Salesforce clean, from leads and contacts to campaigns, activity capture, and attribution, so the numbers in every pipeline review hold up.• Run the content engine for sales, from the Brand Hub to the tooling that turns Product Marketing's material into decks, films and one-pagers a rep can send the same dayWhat success looks like in the first 12 months• After 3 months, two outbound plays are live end to end with reported conversion, Clay enrichment and the BD funnel view are yours, and you write our first touches yourself.• After 6 months, the BDRs run a play library without you, the whole sales team uses one of your agents every week, and qualified pipeline traces back to your plays.• After 12 months, you are the person everyone asks "how do we get into this account?", and the top-of-funnel engine runs every week without a push.Your Experience Must-have• 2 to 4 years in B2B go-to-market as a BDR, SDR, growth or sales ops hire at a startup or running experiments (hypothesis, small test, numbers, next step) and a preference for launching something rough on Tuesday over polishing it for a month.• Fluent German and English, since most of our outreach goes to German engineering leaders.Strong plus• SQL or SOQL, Python or TypeScript.• Salesforce admin experience, or time in Salesloft, Apollo, or HubSpot.• Experience selling to automotive, manufacturing, or engineering-software buyers.• A side project, newsletter, or LinkedIn presence that shows you can create demandWhy SPREAD?You sell AI for engineering to the biggest names in automotive and industry, with a product that customers run in production. The SOS Children's Villages worldwide Hermann-Gmeiner-Fonds Deutschland e.V. is an independent, non-denominational children's rights organization. jobs.occupation: PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) in Heidelberg, starting in January 2027, is offering PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) is recruiting PhD candidates to develop AI agents that interpret medical images, use analysis tools, evaluate intermediate results, and adapt their approach based on evidence and feedback.Candidates will join a collaborative research environment with clinical partners, extensive computing infrastructure, and connections to initiatives such as Helmholtz Imaging.Your TasksWe investigate how AI agents can combine medical images with clinical information, plan and execute analytical steps, learn from feedback, assess intermediate results, and respond appropriately to uncertainty or failure. Approaches may include reinforcement learning, multimodal learning, vision-language models, planning, tool-augmented language models, probabilistic modelling, and classical medical image analysis.Candidates may work primarily in one of several application areas:1. multimodal agents for prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment support;2. auditable analysis of longitudinal imaging for tumour-response assessment;3. federated multimodal agents connecting oral imaging with systemic health information; or4. or reinforcement learning for agents that navigate and integrate complex data across medical and other scientific domains.The individual PhD topic will be developed jointly based on the candidate’s interests, expertise, and the methodological questions arising across these applications.You will:- develop agents that combine medical images with clinical text and other information;- investigate reinforcement learning for planning, tool use, feedback integration, and iterative improvement;- apply agentic methods to segmentation, annotation, quantitative analysis, or scientific data exploration;- establish rigorous evaluation methods covering accuracy, robustness, generalisation, uncertainty calibration, failure detection, and appropriate abstention; and- collaborate with methodological and clinical researchers, publish your results, and contribute reusable software or benchmarks.Your ProfileYou should have:- A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline- A strong foundation in machine learning and strong Python programming skills- Practical experience with a deep-learning framework such as PyTorch- Experience in at least one relevant area, such as reinforcement learning, computer vision, language models, multimodal learning, or medical-image analysis- An analytical and collaborative working style and good communication skills in EnglishPrevious experience with medical data is helpful but not required. We also welcome candidates with strong machine-learning fundamentals who want to develop expertise in agentic AI.What you can excpect:- Scientific freedom to develop your own methodological research question- Close supervision and exchange within a cohort of PhD researchers- Access to extensive GPU infrastructure, medical-imaging resources, and established research software- Collaboration with international machine-learning and clinical partners- Support for conference participation, open-source contributions, and professional development- Fully funded PhD submissionPlease submit:- your CV- academic transcripts- a brief research statement of no more than one page describing a question in agentic AI that interests you- your preferred application area, or a ranking of the available areas- your master’s thesis or another representative piece of scientific work- links to relevant publications, software, or code repositories, if available- Instead of a generic motivation letter, please use your research statement to explain which scientific question you would like to investigate, why it matters, and how you might approach itWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- Access to international research networks- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Constantin Ulrich HarsyPhone: +49 (0) 6221/42-3552Duration: The positions are initially limited to 3 years.Application Deadline: December 2, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.
